description: FEMA P-2335: Database of repaired reinforced concrete frame components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Mehdi Sarrafzadeh, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). Welcome to the Database of repaired reinforced concrete frame elements! This database is a collection of experimental programs on reinforced concrete (RC) frame elements repaired after different levels of visible damage. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 6 top-level files (PDF, CSV, ZIP). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-8h8f-5j24. Keywords: Reinforced concrete, Frame elements, Post-earthquake assessment, Visible damage, Repair, Experimental testing. Published 2024-07-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
